title: Mixed-universe global Hom base-change exchange
statement: For arbitrary scheme maps f:X→Y and g:Y′→Y and M,N∈D(X), the mixed-universe global Hom pullback/direct-image comparisons satisfy the exchange square: pull back Hom(M,N), transport its scalar action by the canonical scalar-square iso, apply direct-image Hom, and precompose in the first Hom entry by β_M; this equals direct-image Hom followed by the pullback comparison and postcomposition by β_N. Here β is the canonical derived base-change mate. No invertibility or counit-square hypothesis is imposed, and the sheaf and module localization universes are independent. Comparisons are those of [lem-sc-flat-affine-global-hom-comparison, lem-sc-mixed-hom-direct-image-comparison, lem-sc-mixed-global-sections-direct-image-iso].

source.place: Tag 0AA8, lemma-more-base-change, final commutative diagrams; evaluation-mate comparisons of Tags 08I3 and 0B6I

proof.text: Expand the pullback and direct-image Hom comparisons as evaluation mates. Transpose both paths under the canonical tensor-Hom and pullback/direct-image bijections. Expand the base-change mate as the canonical pullback composition isomorphism followed by the counit. Counit naturality and the triangle identity identify the two tensor-evaluation composites. On K-flat representatives the tensorators respect composition since both are ordinary tensor pullback; their localization equations transport the equality. Leray respects composition by uniqueness of the right-derived comparison with the same unit, giving exactly the canonical scalar square. This gives the exchange identity with β_M in the first entry and β_N in the second.

theorem mixedGlobalHom_baseChange_exchange
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (R : Type u) [Ring R], HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (M N : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction f).map
        (mixedGlobalHomPullbackComparison (pullback.fst f g) M N) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarSquareIso f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition).hom.app
          ((schemeGlobalDerivedHom (pullback f g)).obj
            (op ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M),
              (derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj N)) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
        (mixedGlobalHomDirectImageMap (pullback.snd f g)
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M)
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj N)) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
        ((schemeGlobalDerivedHom Y').map
          (X := (op ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj
            ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M)),
            (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj
              ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj N)))
          (Y := (op ((derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj M)),
            (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj
              ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj N)))
          ((schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
            (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition M).op, 𝟙 _)) =
    mixedGlobalHomDirectImageMap f M N ≫
      mixedGlobalHomPullbackComparison g
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj M) ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj N) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
        ((schemeGlobalDerivedHom Y').map
          ((𝟙 _).op, schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
            (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition N))
